criteria.evidence: Actual current/history/index reads use KV streams and a geometrically grown buffer capped at 2,097,152 bytes before fatal UTF-8 decode and JSON.parse. Oversize/failing reads cancel and release the acquired reader; only provider null is absence. Independent cases admit exact-limit current/history data, exercise tiny/empty chunks and malformed data, and stop all three overflow paths after two pulls without parsing or validation. Existing public null/[]/fallback behavior, both envelope aliases, immutable history, W38.01/.02 cache and publication controls remain.

Strict uncached mutation current/rollback/index reads reject unreadable, oversized or malformed state, unsafe counters, mismatched historical revision and observed index regression before puts. Both exact serialized strings, including duplicated value/config, metadata and next index/version, are prepared and byte-admitted before the first put. Independent no-put assertions compare complete synthetic KV state for refused replace/patch/rollback operations; an exact 2 MiB output is stored unchanged. The real non-demo Reflex wrapper now uses the strict base, preserving an externally updated unpatched field despite an older serving cache and refusing missing customer config. Mounted handlers return fixed no-store 413/503 errors. Lost put acknowledgement remains a partial/unknown storage error, not a size refusal or rollback claim.

Ten exact owned deltas reconstructed forward and backward against retained baseline; all 39 artifact pins and 23 protected pins match before/after. One independent unchanged K3 invocation passes 23 with 135 unselected. Complete final worker compiler/lint/whitespace captures reused: zero errors and four inherited warnings, one fewer than baseline because the stream adapter now consumes _type. Three new groups and six existing fixture adapters only. Earlier fixture failure, superseded pass and compiler failure remain recorded; historical overlapping byte proof is qualified, not silently reapproved.
